schema: CREATE TABLE Students (student_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE Enrollments (enrollment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_id INTEGER, course_code TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES Students(student_id));
correct_query: SELECT Students.student_id AS student_id, student_name FROM (SELECT student_id, SUM(IIF(course_code = 'Math', 1, 0)) AS has_math, SUM(IIF(course_code = 'Physics', 1, 0)) AS has_phys, SUM(IIF(course_code = 'History', 1, 0)) AS has_hist FROM Enrollments GROUP BY student_id) AS inter JOIN Students ON Students.student_id = inter.student_id WHERE has_math > 0 AND has_phys > 0 AND has_hist = 0 ORDER BY student_id

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name FROM Students AS s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM Enrollments WHERE course_code IN ('Math')) AS m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM Enrollments WHERE course_code IN ('Physics')) AS p ON s.student_id = p.student_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM Enrollments WHERE course_code = 'History') AS h ON m.student_id = h.student_id WHERE h.student_id IS NULL
